[[File:Brine rat icon.png|left]]
'''Brine rats''' are creatures found within the [[Brine Rat Cavern]], which requires partial completion of [[Olaf's Quest]] and a [[spade]] ([[tool belt]] works) to access. They require level 47 [[Slayer]] to damage.

Multiple [[safe spot]]s exist, one of them involving the use of the light coloured skeleton in the room. [[Ranged]], [[Magic]], and [[Necromancy]] can be used attack across these bones, trapping the monsters on the other side of the pile.

==Tips==
'''Access tips:'''
#Use the [[Fremennik Province lodestone]]
#Use the [[fairy ring]]s {{Fairy code|DKS}} and dig the area just west of the tree
#Use a [[ring of slaying]] Teleport to the [[Rellekka Slayer Dungeon]] and then run north
#Use the [[lyre]] teleport run east

Food such as [[swordfish]] or using [[Bones to Peaches]] spell would be helpful for staying longer.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Rune Value Improvements|date=15 September 2014}}
